# Tides of Urashima — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org/ — curated map for AI agents (progressive disclosure)
# Full router: docs/INDEX.yaml · Humans: docs/README.md · Boot: docs/ops/BOOT.md

> Stylized Japanese coastal JRPG (Godot 4.7). Docs on `main`; implementation on `game/development`.

## Boot (always)

- [Agent boot card](ops/BOOT.md): MCP stack commands, STOP conditions, authority chain
- [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md): Cloud bootstrap + branch rules
- [Index router](INDEX.yaml): role → must_read paths
- Session gate prints the pack via `python3 tools/resolve_docs.py <role> --issue <id> --budget 12000`

**Rule:** load hub + **one pack** for your pass — do not preload full bibles.
